input.description: cold-start benchmark: 5 iterations of am force-stop + am start -W for dev.lincforge.benchtarget
input.command:
DEV=<REDACTED-1>
PKG=dev.lincforge.benchtarget
ACT=$(adb -s $DEV shell cmd package resolve-activity --brief $PKG | tail -1 | tr -d '\r')
echo "launch_activity=$ACT"
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  adb -s $DEV shell am force-stop $PKG
  sleep 3
  RUNNING=$(adb -s $DEV shell pidof $PKG)
  OUT=$(adb -s $DEV shell am start -W -n "$ACT")
  TOTAL=$(echo "$OUT" | grep -i TotalTime)
  STATUS=$(echo "$OUT" | grep -i Status)
  echo "iter=$i pre_pid=[$RUNNING] $STATUS $TOTAL"
  sleep 2
done
echo "DONE"
